dedupe_keys.name: danish telecom statistics telestatistik internet mobile and fixed telephony datasheets

description: The Telestatistik is the Danish telecom authority's official statistics on the telecom market, published by the Agency for Digital Government. Since 2025 it is annual; until 2024 it was half-yearly. The current release offers main figures, an internet datasheet, a mobile datasheet, a fixed telephony datasheet and a list of providers and corporate groups, and older half-yearly datasheets and main results (for example for the second half of 2024, with background sheets) remain available but are no longer maintained. Related publications on the agency's statistics page include the annual economic key figures for the telecom sector (revenue, EBIT, investment and employment, with investment from 2018 to 2025), projections of the addresses without at least 100/30 Mbit/s and, from 2022, without 1 Gbit/s, produced from 2020 to 2023, and the Nordic-Baltic telecom statistics. Coverage: Denmark. Format and access: XLSX datasheets and PDF summaries, free. Caveats: provider-reported figures; the switch from half-yearly to annual breaks series; the agency disclaims liability for errors. Simulation uses: subscription, traffic and investment inputs for Danish telecom demand and capacity models. Related records: Tjekditnet gives coverage by address, and the Nordic-Baltic telecom statistics compare Denmark with its neighbours.
